title: Production Risk: Deployment of Unrestricted Test Harnesses
vuln_type: Access Control / Privilege Escalation / Unbounded Minting
impact: Total loss of funds, token inflation, or arbitrary state corruption. Test harnesses like `ERC721Harness`, `ERC20FlashMintHarness`, and `ERC20PermitHarness` expose public/external `mint()` and `burn()` functions without access control modifiers (`onlyOwner`, `onlyRole`).
